$comment: Deterministic 0D quasi-steady M64/60 virtual bench. Not a measured part: hypothesis-grade simulation, see inputs-gap.md for every missing input.

solver.name: closed-form 0D quasi-steady evaluation
solver.iterations: none (no iterative solve; linear 2x2 calibration solve only)
solver.convergence: N/A by construction; determinism = byte-identical reruns

versions.solver: deterministic 0D quasi-steady closed-form evaluation (no iterative solver)

compressor_pr_curve.note: PR=1.0 below spool; plateau = published 0.8 bar gauge

verdicts.air: AIR: charge flow closes the public 0.8 bar plateau with the VE shape inside the REPO 0.85-1.0 envelope near peak; per-turbo flow 0.169 kg/s sits within +-3% of the 0.156 kg/s REPO variants anchor at mid-high rpm; PR curve is an unverified map hypothesis (M64-ACQ-0003).
verdicts.fuel: FUEL: energy balance at AFR 12 reproduces 300 kW at 5750 rpm exactly (calibration) and 556 Nm at 4050 rpm as a blind prediction; BSFC min 288 g/kWh is plausible for a turbocharged SI; fuel card missing (M64-ACQ-BENCH-05).
verdicts.oil_thermal: OIL/THERMAL: oil flow demand 3 L/min at peak vs NO sourced pump curve (M64-ACQ-BENCH-02); fan-air 1.20 kg/s implies cooling-air dT 307 K at the assumed 372 kW air share - the fan is the thermal bottleneck until the split and hA are measured (M64-ACQ-BENCH-04).
